description: This file defines an interface `NamespacedEntityId` which specifies methods for retrieving a named entity's namespace and name within the Eclipse Ditto project. It also includes licensing information and package declaration.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityId
classes.description: An interface representing entity IDs that include a namespace, with methods to retrieve name and namespace components.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name part of the entity ID.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the entity ID.
